note: Recast from the original description of the new species by Snyder 1924 (in English), published there as Prorhinotermes molinoi sp. n., the type locality Largo Remo Island, Canal Zone, Panama; the alate (with complete measurements) and the soldier (with complete measurements) are described and the worker is not. The original gives the measurements as mean—range or as single values; they are copied here, with the range joined by "—".

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head greyish brown, darker than in P. simplex; head slightly longer than wide, the posterior part slightly wider than the anterior, with 3 transverse rows of scattered long hairs; fontanelle distinct, transparent, nearly oval, on the line of the posterior margin of the ocelli; eyes black, nearly round, large and projecting, less than one eye diameter from the lateral margin of the head and slightly less than two eye diameters from the posterior margin; ocelli transparent, nearly elliptical, narrow, pointed at the ends, almost touching the eye, oblique to the eye and almost parallel to the anterior margin of the pronotum. Soldier head far wider posteriorly than anteriorly, the mandibles stouter than in P. simplex and less narrowed towards the apex; the head is larger than in the Samoan P. inopinatus and the pronotum larger than in P. simplex of the West Indies and Florida, with different venation, while from the Cocos Islands P. oceanicus it differs in the number of antennal segments (22 in the latter) and in the venation.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head greyish brown, darker than in P. simplex Hagen; with a "spectacles-shaped" pattern on the head; head slightly longer than wide, the posterior part slightly wider than the anterior, with a few scattered long hairs in 3 transverse rows. Fontanelle an evident, transparent, nearly oval spot, on the line of the posterior margin of the ocelli. Eyes black, nearly round, large, projecting, less than one eye diameter from the lateral margin of the head and slightly less than two eye diameters from the posterior margin. Ocelli transparent, nearly elliptical, narrow, pointed at the ends, almost touching the eye, oblique to the eye and almost parallel to the upper margin of the antennal socket. Postclypeus paler than the head, bilobed, projecting. Labrum paler than the head, arched and lingulate, wider than long, widest behind the middle transverse line, with long hairs at the apex. Antenna yellowish brown, 17 or 18 segments, hairy; segment 3 shorter and narrower than segments 2 and 4; the segments wedge-shaped, widening and lengthening towards the apex; apical segment long, nearly elliptical. Pronotum concolorous with the head, wider than long, the anterior margin slightly rounded and concave, the sides curving smoothly to the convex posterior margin, the margins with scattered long hairs. Legs yellowish brown, fairly long, hairy. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 9.50; body length without wings 5.0—5.5; head length 1.50; pronotum length 0.77; forewing length 7.50; hind tibia length 1.17; eye diameter 0.32; head width 1.40; pronotum width 1.10—1.20; forewing width 2.30.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly, far wider posteriorly than anteriorly, with a few scattered long hairs in several transverse rows; fontanelle an evident transparent spot, on the line of the eye spots; eye spots transparent, large, nearly oval. Labrum yellowish brown, long, fairly narrow, rounded and with long hairs at the apex. Mandibles dark reddish brown, stouter and wider than in P. simplex Hagen, narrowing less towards the apex. Antenna yellowish brown (broken in the specimen), hairy, segment 3 nearly club-shaped, longer than segment 4 but slightly shorter than segment 2, the segments wedge-shaped. Maxillary palps very long and slender, as long as the mandibles. Pronotum slightly darker than the head, wider than long, widest near the anterior margin, slightly concave, the sides curving smoothly to a nearly straight posterior margin. Legs pale yellowish brown, fairly long. Measurements (mm): total soldier length 5.75—6.20; head length with mandibles 2.90—3.00; head length without the mandibles, to the anterior margin 1.90; left mandible length 1.15—1.20; pronotum length 0.70—0.80; hind tibia length 1.20; head width at the widest posterior part 1.60—1.65; head width at the anterior margin 1.0—1.1; pronotum width 1.20—1.30.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original records that this species is presumably not subterranean in habit, boring along the grain when it attacks wood, and hollowing out even the hardest timber; type locality Largo Remo Island, Canal Zone, Panama.
